dataset.name: High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (CPTAC prospective)
dataset.description: Independent prospective CPTAC ovarian HGSC cohort with harmonized bulk RNA-seq and linked overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: CPTAC prospectively collected 83 new treatment-naive ovarian HGSC tumors at 12 tissue-source sites. The PDC pan-cancer freeze contains 82 tumor RNA profiles; 79 have positive overall-survival time and explicit status, including six deaths and 73 censored observations. These cases were collected independently of the earlier CPTAC proteomic study of TCGA ovarian tumors.
dataset.publication_citation: McDermott et al. Cell Reports Medicine 2020

metadata.source_data_system: NCI Proteomic Data Commons pan-cancer data freeze v1
metadata.redistribution_note: PDC states that its data are available under CC BY 4.0. The CPTAC BCM GENCODE mapping snapshot is also archived under CC BY 4.0 at Zenodo.
metadata.curation_note: The official PDC clinical archive supplies exact OS_days and OS_event fields. The versioned LinkedOmics data-freeze expression member is accepted only after its SHA-256 matches the same HGSC member independently extracted from the official PDC RNA_BCM_v1 archive. Versioned Ensembl identifiers are mapped with the CPTAC BCM GENCODE v34 snapshot; every symbol represented by more than one Ensembl identifier is excluded rather than merged.

source.mapping_release: GENCODE v34 basic (CHR), CPTAC BCM snapshot; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8034305

expression.label: log2(RSEM-UQ + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned CPTAC BCM GENCODE v34 basic (CHR) annotation mapping
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols represented by more than one Ensembl gene are all excluded rather than combined without a source-defined aggregation rule.
expression.scale_note: The CPTAC BCM pipeline supplies gene-level RSEM abundance after upper-quartile normalization and log2(value + 1) transformation. TRACE Explorer preserves the released values without another transformation.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Diagnosis as encoded in the CPTAC pan-cancer clinical freeze
